GENERAL PROVISIONS
This Privacy Policy describes the purposes and procedures used to process personal data and the measures taken to protect it.

The Policy has been prepared in accordance with Federal Law No. 152-FZ of 27 July 2006 “On Personal Data” and other applicable laws of the Russian Federation governing personal data and information security.

The Operator’s principal objective is to respect the rights and freedoms of individuals when processing their personal data, including the rights to privacy and to personal and family confidentiality.

This Policy applies to information and personal data that the Operator may obtain when a User visits https://www.aoplastic.com/, places an order, submits a request, or uses the Website’s services and forms. A User who does not agree with the Policy must stop using the Website.
The Operator is Joint Stock Company Plastic (JSC Plastic), OGRN 1027100507059, INN 7117000076, legal address: 1 Tulskaya St., Uzlovaya, Uzlovsky District, Tula Region, 301600, Russian Federation.
KEY TERMS

Personal data means any information relating directly or indirectly to an identified or identifiable individual. Processing includes collection, recording, organization, accumulation, storage, correction, retrieval, use, transfer, depersonalization, blocking, deletion and destruction of personal data.
A User is any individual who uses the Website. Cookies are small text files stored on a User’s device that contain information about activity on the Website.
PERSONAL DATA PROCESSING

The Operator may process personal data of customers, prospective customers, counterparties and their representatives, suppliers, Website visitors, applicants, event participants and other individuals who communicate with JSC Plastic.

Depending on the User’s interaction with the Website, processed data may include name, telephone number, email address, company and position, delivery and billing details, the contents of requests and orders, and technical information transmitted by the browser or device.

The Operator processes only the data required for the stated purpose. Special-category and biometric personal data are not intentionally collected through ordinary Website forms unless processing is expressly required and permitted by law.

The purposes of processing include responding to requests, preparing and performing contracts and orders, arranging delivery, maintaining business communications, providing customer support, meeting legal and accounting obligations, protecting the Website, preventing abuse and improving Website operation.

The legal grounds for processing include the Constitution and laws of the Russian Federation, agreements to which the data subject is a party, steps requested before entering into an agreement, the Operator’s legal obligations and the User’s consent where consent is required.

Personal data may be processed using automated systems or without automation. Processing is limited to the purposes for which the data was collected and is performed in a lawful, fair and proportionate manner.

Data is retained only for as long as necessary to achieve the processing purposes or for the period required by law, a contract or valid consent. When the purpose is achieved or consent is withdrawn, data is deleted or destroyed unless another lawful basis requires continued retention.
DISCLOSURE AND CROSS-BORDER TRANSFERS

Personal data is not disclosed to third parties without a lawful basis. The Operator may engage service providers and contractors where this is necessary for Website operation, communications, order fulfilment, delivery, accounting or legal compliance, subject to appropriate confidentiality and data-protection obligations.

Personal data may be disclosed to public authorities where required by Russian law. Cross-border transfers, if any, are performed only after the conditions and safeguards required by applicable law have been satisfied.
USER RIGHTS

A data subject may request information about the processing of their personal data, ask for inaccurate data to be corrected, and request blocking or deletion where the data is incomplete, outdated, inaccurate, unlawfully obtained or no longer required for the stated purpose.

Where processing is based on consent, the User may withdraw that consent by contacting the Operator. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal and may make it impossible to continue a requested service or transaction.

Requests relating to personal data may be sent to info@td-plastic.ru or to the Operator’s postal address. The Operator may ask for information necessary to verify the requester’s identity and authority.
COOKIES AND TECHNICAL DATA

The Website may use essential, preference and analytics cookies to operate correctly, remember settings, understand aggregate usage and improve the Website. Users can limit or delete cookies through browser settings, although some Website functions may then be unavailable.

When the Website is used, technical data such as IP address, browser and device type, operating system, referring page, visited pages and access time may be processed for security, diagnostics and analytics.
CONFIDENTIALITY AND SECURITY

The Operator applies legal, organizational and technical safeguards appropriate to the nature of the data and the identified risks. These measures are intended to prevent unauthorized or accidental access, destruction, alteration, blocking, copying, disclosure and other unlawful processing.
Employees and contractors who receive access to personal data are required to maintain confidentiality and may process data only within the scope of their duties and instructions.
UPDATES AND CONTACTS

The Operator may update this Policy when legislation, processing procedures or Website functionality changes. The current version is published on this page and takes effect when posted unless a later effective date is specified.
Questions about this Policy and personal data processing may be sent to JSC Plastic at info@td-plastic.ru or by telephone at +7 (495) 201-03-33.
